messages:
nina_writer: Heads-up: drafting a small migration guide section for Dedicated capacity docs that explains label renaming and SLA implications. Putting a draft here before PR.

sam_engineering: Great. Two asks: 1) show both REST and SDK snippet for changing pool isolation flags; 2) make sure we don't call it an "SLA change" without legal sign-off.

nina_writer: Good call. Draft REST curl sample below: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/team-pool -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD' -d '{"tenant_isolation": true}'
```

kevin_sre: Note: changing tenant_isolation on an existing pool will trigger a reconcile window and may cause rolling restarts. Add a short note recommending doing this in off-peak hours.

matthew_legal: Quick flag: any language that affects customer SLAs needs to be routed through legal. You can state "operational behavior may change" but don't assert new SLA coverage.

nina_writer: I'll phrase it as "operational effect" not SLA edit. Also adding a tiny Terraform example mapping labels to pool: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "team" {
  name = "team-pool"
  tenant_isolation = true
  labels = { migrated_from = "legacy-tenant" }
}
```

build-bot: CI: spellcheck passed.

sam_engineering: Small nit: in the REST sample payload use `tenant_isolation` (docs API uses snake_case). Also add a note that the API will return 202 with async job id.

nina_writer: Updated wording in draft. I'll open the PR after a quick internal review. Target merge Wed.

kevin_sre: Also add a tiny troubleshooting bullet about `NodeAffinity` conflicts if the pool requests a GPU SKU not available in region. We've seen this in QA.

nina_writer: Will add two bullets: reconcile window + node affinity conflict. Thanks everyone.
